title: Korean dependency-distance perturbation corpora and fine-tuned model outputs
description: Five aligned Korean training corpora (original, LLM rewrite, and three tree-fixed reorderings that decrease, increase, or preserve mean dependency distance), 34,000 outputs of fine-tuned language models, parsed features from Stanza and UDPipe, and all code. Resource for a manuscript submitted to Language Resources and Evaluation.
